messages.subject: WC-00146 - draft settlement agreement (v1) for review
messages.plaintextBody:
Robert, Grace,

Attached is our first draft of the settlement agreement (v1) reflecting the opening position - £95,000 ex gratia, PILON of £71,000, the waiver of claims, and crucially the express preservation of Dr Saxena's right to make protected disclosures. This is clean (no tracked changes) and will be the version we send to the other side once you're happy. Grateful for any comments.

James Osei
Senior Associate | Employment
Whitfield Carter LLP
22 Bishopsgate, London EC2N 4BQ | +44 (0)20 7946 0211
